DOWNLOAD & REQUIREMENTS

Simple to install. Easy to run.

Comic Converter is a standalone Windows app. Download the ZIP, extract it, and run the app. No Python or installer is required.

📦 Download size: 31.1 MB for the current Windows package. The final download size may change slightly with future releases.

Internet is only needed to download the app. Your comics stay on your computer while they are converted.

System requirements

  • OSWindows 10 or Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Memory4 GB RAM minimum • 8 GB recommended
  • StorageAt least 100 MB free, plus enough space for your output CBZ files
  • PythonNot required
  • InternetOnly needed to download the app

How to install

  1. Download the Comic Converter ZIP.
  2. Open your Downloads folder.
  3. Right-click the ZIP and choose Extract All.
  4. Open the extracted Comic Converter folder.
  5. Double-click Comic Converter.exe.

Windows' built-in Extract All is all you need. If you prefer a dedicated ZIP program, 7-Zip is a good free option.

FAQ

Questions, answered.

Do I need Python?

No. The downloadable Windows version is a standalone executable.

Does Comic Converter upload my comics?

No. The desktop app processes your files locally on your computer.

What is CBZ?

CBZ is a comic-book archive format supported by many comic reading applications.

Is Comic Converter free?

Version 1.0.0 is planned as a free download. If you like it, voluntary support through Ko-fi helps keep the project going.
